home.intro: Samvid explains screening results in plain words, connects you with qualified genetic counsellors, and lets you decide what to share.
home.does_1_b: Plain language about what a finding means, without alarm or jargon.
home.does_2_b: Options are never ranked. The choice is yours.
home.does_3_b: Clinical questions and hard moments go to a person, not a machine.
home.does_4_b: Findings are encrypted when stored. You choose who sees what, and can stop at any time.
home.facts_title: Facts to know before and after testing
home.fact_1_t: Being a carrier usually doesn't cause illness
home.fact_1_b: A carrier has one changed copy of a gene and one working copy.
home.fact_2_t: 1 in 4 is a chance for each pregnancy
home.fact_2_b: It isn't a count of children. Chance has no memory between pregnancies.
home.fact_3_t: Most people carry a few gene changes
home.fact_3_b: Carrying a change is a normal part of human variation.
home.honest_title: What we can and can't promise
home.honest_body: Your results are encrypted when stored and are processed on our server, which holds the keys. A couple check compares results on that server, and only what you both agreed to is shown. No test finds everything, so a clear result never means no risk.
learn.inherit_intro: You have two copies of most genes, one from each parent. Each parent passes on one copy, by chance.
learn.recessive_t: When both partners carry the same change
learn.recessive_b: In each pregnancy there is a 1 in 4 chance that a child inherits two copies, a 1 in 2 chance of one copy, and a 1 in 4 chance of neither. Inheriting two copies doesn't affect everyone in the same way.
learn.xlinked_t: When a change is on the X chromosome
learn.xlinked_b: Men have one X and women have two, so these changes pass on differently and can affect sons and daughters differently. This is why a square drawn for one pattern can't be used for the other.
learn.carrier_b: Being a carrier usually doesn't cause illness, though some carriers can have mild symptoms. A counsellor can say more about your own finding.
learn.cousins_intro: Marrying a relative is common in many families and cultures. Nobody here will tell you what to do. These are facts to help you decide for yourself.
learn.myth_1_t: Is it true that related couples can't have healthy children?
learn.myth_1_b: No. Most children of related couples have no inherited condition. The chance of a recessive condition is somewhat higher than for unrelated couples, because relatives are more likely to share a change.
learn.myth_2_t: If our test finds nothing shared, is there no risk?
learn.myth_2_b: No test can promise that. A screening panel looks at particular genes and doesn't find every change, so some chance always remains.
learn.myth_3_t: Does screening mean we can't marry?
learn.myth_3_b: A result gives information. It isn't a verdict. What you do with it is your decision, and a counsellor can go through the options available where you live.
privacy.title: Our privacy promise
privacy.intro: Genetic data is permanent and shared across a family, so the most private choice is the default. Each promise below is one this prototype actually enforces.
privacy.p1_b: Nothing is shared unless you agree. Each share has an end date, and you can stop it at any time.
privacy.p2_t: A couple check shows only what's shared
privacy.p2_b: Your other findings stay private. If you have just one finding, a "yes" also tells your partner which gene it is, and we say so before you agree.
privacy.p3_b: Every view is recorded in a log that can't be quietly changed, and you can read it.
privacy.p4_t: You can choose not to know
privacy.p4_b: Where the law allows it, you can ask not to see your results. Some serious findings may still need a conversation with a counsellor.
privacy.p5_t: Let relatives know without saying who you are
privacy.p5_b: An invitation shows general information, and nothing about you unless you choose.
privacy.limits_b: Our server holds the encryption keys and can decrypt your results to work with them, so you are trusting the service that runs it. This prototype hasn't had an independent security test, and it holds no compliance certificates.
start.title: Start privately
start.country_help: This sets which rules, options and languages apply. Other countries can be added once a local team has reviewed them.
start.sign_in_note: In this demo you sign in with a test account. A real service would use a verified national ID.
start.error.sign_in: Sign-in didn't finish. Please try again.
start.error.already_linked: This identity is already linked to another login.
start.error.unavailable: The service is briefly unavailable. Please try again soon.
start.consent_1: Samvid explains results and connects you with people who can help. It doesn't diagnose, and it won't tell you what to decide.
start.consent_2: Your results are encrypted when stored. Counsellors see them only when you're in their care or in a recorded emergency.
start.consent_3: Parts of the service may use AI to explain things. Numbers always come from tested rules, never from AI, and hard questions go to a person.
start.consent_4: You can withdraw this agreement or stop any share at any time.

dash.title: My journey
dash.result_none: No lab report on file yet. This isn't a result.
dash.result_ready: A report is on file. Take your time, and read it when you're ready.
dash.result_withheld: You've chosen not to see your results. You can change this at any time.
dash.partner_none: No partner linked. This is optional.
dash.care_none: No follow-up is open. You can still ask to talk to someone.
dash.privacy_b: See who viewed your data, and manage what you share.
care.RESULT_RELEASED: Your result is ready to read.
care.COUNSELLING_REQUESTED: A counsellor will be in touch.
result.title: My result
result.no_report_t: We don't have a lab report for you yet
result.no_report_b: This isn't a negative result. It means we have nothing to explain yet.
result.nothing_t: No reportable findings on the tested panel
result.nothing_b: This doesn't mean there's no risk. Tests don't find every change, and some genes aren't tested.
result.withheld_t: You've chosen not to see your results
result.withheld_b: Your results stay hidden on every screen. You can change this in the privacy centre.
result.contact_b: There's something a counsellor needs to talk through with you in person. It's a conversation, and nothing about it is shown here.
result.what_next: What happens next is up to you. A counsellor can go through this with you.
fact.carrier: You carry one changed copy of this gene. Being a carrier usually doesn't cause illness.
fact.possible_affected: This finding needs a conversation with a counsellor. It may matter for your own health, and only a clinician can say.
fact.uncertain: The lab found a change whose meaning isn't known yet. We can't give a number for this, and a counsellor can explain it.
fact.refer: This finding is outside what we can assess here, so a specialist needs to look at it. This isn't a negative result.
fact.review: This needs a counsellor to look at both results together. We can't give a number for it.
fact.background: Because you're related, there is some added background chance that a panel can't measure. A counsellor can explain what this means for you.
fact.chance.two_copies: {percent}% chance (1 in {one_in}) in each pregnancy that a child inherits two copies.
fact.chance.carrier: {percent}% chance in each pregnancy that a child inherits one copy, as a carrier.
fact.chance.neither: {percent}% chance in each pregnancy that a child inherits neither copy.
fact.chance.son_affected: {percent}% chance for each son of inheriting this change.
fact.chance.daughter_carrier: {percent}% chance for each daughter of inheriting one copy, as a carrier.
fact.chance.daughter_two_copies: {percent}% chance for each daughter of inheriting two copies.
fact.chance.daughter_neither: {percent}% chance for each daughter of inheriting neither copy.
visual.icon_title: Out of {total} pregnancies like yours, on average
visual.memory: Chance has no memory between pregnancies.
visual.punnett_title: What each parent can pass on
visual.punnett_help: A means a working copy and a means a changed copy.

partner.title: Partner sharing
partner.intro: Comparing results is optional, and you can stop at any time.
partner.step1_b: Create a code and give it to your partner yourself. It works once, for 7 days.
partner.relationship: Are you related to each other?
partner.relationship_help: This changes the figures. If your two answers differ, the closer relationship is used.
partner.code_once: We show this only once, so copy it now.
partner.have_code: Have a code from your partner?
partner.join_failed: That code didn't work. Ask your partner for a new one.
partner.waiting: Waiting for your partner to join.
partner.step2: Choose what a check may show
partner.reveal_yes_no_b: You learn whether you share a finding, with no gene names.
partner.reveal_genes_b: You see which gene you share, if you both choose this.
partner.more_private: If you choose differently, the more private choice is used.
partner.understood: I've read this, and I understand what a result can reveal.
partner.step3_b: It runs only when you've both agreed. We don't show what your partner has chosen.
partner.not_ready: Not ready yet. It needs both of you to have agreed.
couple.title: Couple check
couple.none_shared: No shared finding on the tested panels
couple.cannot_determine: We can't compare your results yet
couple.care_opened: A counsellor has been asked to follow this up with each of you.
couple.not_diagnosis: This isn't a diagnosis, and it doesn't tell you what to do.
family.title: Tell a relative
family.intro: Your relatives may want to know about screening. An invitation lets you encourage them without saying who you are or what your result is.
family.relation: Who is it for? This stays private unless you choose below.
family.disclose: Tell them they're hearing this from a relative of this kind
family.link_once: We show this only once. It works for 30 days, and a link preview in a messaging app won't use it up.
family.limit: You can create up to 5 a day.
family.rate_limited: You've reached today's limit. Please try again tomorrow.
invite.title: Someone who cares about you thought you'd want to know this
invite.from_relation: This comes from a relative of yours: {relation}.
invite.body: Some health conditions run in families and can be passed on without anyone knowing. Carrier screening looks for changes in particular genes. Whether to have it is entirely your choice.
invite.private: We don't know anything about you, and opening this page tells nobody that you did.
invite.availability: Availability and cost depend on where you live, so ask a local health service.
invite.thanks: Thank you. You can close this page now.
invite.unavailable_b: It may have been used already or have expired.
centre.title: Privacy centre
centre.stop_unavailable: We couldn't stop this just now, so it's still active. Please try again.
centre.share_new_b: Ask them for a share code from this page, then enter it here. Nobody can be looked up by name.
centre.share_failed: That code didn't work. Codes work once, for 15 minutes.
centre.receive_t: Someone wants to share with you?
centre.receive_b: Create a code and give it to them. It works once, for 15 minutes.
centre.rtnk_b: You can ask not to see your results. Couple checks and shares stop while this is on. Where the law requires it, a counsellor may still need to talk to you about something serious.
centre.withdraw_b: This withdraws your agreement, and your results stop being shown. Health records may have to be kept for the period the law requires.
shared.title: Shared with you
shared.summary_note: This is a summary. The person who shared it can stop sharing at any time.
shared.full_note: The person who shared this can stop sharing at any time. Please keep it private.
shared.gone_b: It may have ended, or it may not exist.
staff.title: Care cases
staff.queue_note: The counsellor queue arrives in sub-phase 4.5. For now, a case opens from its ID.
staff.through_bg: You're viewing this through emergency access. It's flagged in the person's log and will be reviewed.
staff.no_access_t: You don't have access to this case
staff.bg_b: Only for a genuine emergency. It lasts one hour, the person can see it in their log, and someone else reviews it. Please don't put health details in the reason.
review.title: Emergency access to review
review.own: You can't review your own access.
later.title: This part isn't built yet
later.body: It arrives in sub-phase {phase} of the plan. Nothing here is simulated.
error.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Your data is safe.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
error.unavailable: This service is briefly unavailable. Please try again soon.
ask.title: Ask Samvid
ask.intro: Ask about your result or about inheritance. Questions about your own health, a pregnancy or a decision go to a counsellor, who will contact you.
ask.label: Your question
ask.escalated: A counsellor has been alerted and will contact you.
ask.disclosure: Answers come from reviewed text, with numbers only from tested rules. They're general information, not medical advice.
options.title: Your options
options.intro: These are the options available where you live. They're listed in no particular order. None is better than another, and the choice is yours.
options.unreviewed: Awaiting review by a local clinician.
options.values_intro: Writing this down can help you think, and it's only for you. Nothing here is scored, and it never changes the options. You can share it with your counsellor if you want to.
values.what_matters: What matters most to you about having children?
values.who_to_involve: Who would you like to involve?
values.timing: How much time would you like to decide?
values.saved: Saved. Only you can see this.
values.no_case: There's no open case to share it with yet.
queue.title: Counsellor queue
queue.no_identity: Cases show no identity or genetic detail until someone takes them on.
